fun_fact: India's commons — its village forests, grazing pastures, wetlands and ponds — sustain hundreds of millions of people and are pillars of climate resilience, yet they are among the first casualties of unchecked development and a warming climate. We can't protect what we don't understand. Land Conflict Watch is documenting 100 Stories of Commons from across India. [Read more](https://www.landconflictwatch.org/storiesofcommons)
